card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The first digit of a section number inside bracketed cross-references like [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3)] or Clinical Pharmacology (12.3). Also fires on a few stray words before a comma in lists.

modes.label: Section number digit
modes.description: The leading digit(s) of a numbered section reference inside parentheses after a section title.

modes.label: Word in a list of actions
modes.description: A verb such as copying in a list of banned uses, just before a comma.

card.writes: It seems to push toward closing punctuation and ellipsis-like tokens, and away from sentence-opening words.
card.plain: It lights up on the section number in a label's "see Warnings and Precautions (5.3)" pointers.
